snippet.title: We Are the Bride of Christ
snippet.description: The Bible tells us that the Church and its relationship with Jesus is best characterized as a husband and wife. What are the implications of this then, in the context of living in community? Our relationship with Jesus (and those we're in Gospel community with) need to be a relationship of priority and utmost importance.
